description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Collective agreement between Employer's Federation of Ceylon Rajagiriya and other Part Ceylon Estate Staff's Union  (Supervisory Staff) - Colombo 03 - The Collective agreement between Employer's Federation of Ceylon Rajagiriya and other part Ceylon Estate Staff's Union (Maintenance & Support Staff) - Colombo 03 (E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between employers and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, conditions, salaries, and dispute resolution procedures. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks governing labor relations.
